event_chain.summary: Network accessed Feb 23-25; files with SSNs and ID numbers copied

summary: Between February 23 and 25, 2026 an external actor accessed Strategic Education Inc.'s computer network and copied files containing names with Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers and/or passport numbers. The for-profit education company determined what data was involved on May 21, notified affected individuals from May 29 and reported the breach to the Maine and California attorneys general on June 1, offering identity monitoring through Kroll. The number of affected people was not disclosed.
